metadata.title: कच्चे कुएं से पानी पीने को मजबूर जनजातीय लोग | Why tribals forced to drink polluted water
metadata.description: In the midst of a severe heatwave gripping India, life in the hilly regions of Tripura, a small northeastern state with a significant tribal population, becomes particularly arduous due to acute water scarcity. In West Tripura district, where 33 percent of the population comprises tribals, the situation is dire. During a recent visit to one such village, the challenges faced by the tribal communities came to light. With limited access to drinking water, their daily lives are marked by hardships exacerbated by the scorching heat. The tribals, deeply entrenched in their hilltop dwellings, struggle to procure even the most basic necessity of life. As temperatures soar, the urgency to address this issue becomes increasingly apparent, highlighting the pressing need for sustainable solutions to ensure the well-being of these marginalized communities amidst the relentless grip of the heatwave.
